subject: South Street Historic District Outreach
overview: The commission coordinated outreach efforts for the proposed South Street Historic District, including property owner notifications and website updates. Members finalized the design and distribution plan for a brochure to be featured at an upcoming community event.

items.title: Website Updates and Property Owner Notification
items.summary: The commission reviewed a notification letter sent to South Street property owners and discussed updates to the official website, including new pages for district guidelines and preliminary reports.

items.title: Historical District Trifold Brochure
items.summary: Members reviewed a draft trifold brochure and delegated revisions to include more specific historical content regarding the South Street area and the 'Grandfather's House'.

items.title: PorchFest Outreach Planning
items.summary: The commission finalized plans to host an information booth at the Grandfather's House during Medford PorchFest on June 3rd to collect community input on the proposed district. Plans were made to print 250 brochures and advertise the event on local social media platforms.
